intent.instructions: Classify one transcribed HerThing voice request. Choose a direct action only when the speaker clearly asks HerThing to do exactly that now. Negated, quoted, hypothetical, ambiguous, unsupported, parameterized, or multiple requests must not execute directly.

criteria.pause_music: explicitly pause or stop the currently playing music now
criteria.resume_music: explicitly resume or continue paused music now
criteria.next_track: explicitly skip the current song and play the next track now
criteria.volume_up: explicitly raise the current system audio volume without specifying an exact level
criteria.volume_down: explicitly lower the current system audio volume without specifying an exact level
criteria.next_calendar_event: ask HerThing to read the next calendar event
criteria.current_weather: ask HerThing to report current local weather
criteria.conversation: general conversation or a supported question that should use the conversational assistant
criteria.fallback: ambiguous, negated, quoted, hypothetical, unsupported, multi-intent, or requires clarification
